inclusion_rule: Studies that synthesize speech from a non-acoustic signal (video, ultrasound, EMG, articulography, neural recordings) and pre-train the speech-generating part of the model (decoder, generator or speech autoencoder) on speech data without the non-acoustic signal, then transfer it into the signal-to-speech model. Boundary: an off-the-shelf pretrained vocoder used alone is counted separately (pretrained_vocoder_only), encoder-side self-supervised pre-training on the non-acoustic signal belongs to M03 self-supervised-pretraining, audio-visual paired pre-training (VoxCeleb2) is counted separately, knowledge distillation into a visual encoder belongs to M02 audio-knowledge-transfer-to-video; full-text design counts are pattern matches (upper bounds, mentions included); versions counted once.
